description: Source file containing unit tests for the JPEG transcoding functionality in the OpenClawKit project. Defines a test suite 'JPEGTranscoderTests' with helper methods to create JPEG images and multiple test cases verifying image downscaling, normalization of orientation, and maximum byte size constraints.

classes.name: JPEGTranscoderTests
classes.description: A test suite for verifying JPEG transcoding functionality, including image size adjustments, orientation normalization, and size constraints.

methods.name: makeSolidJPEG
methods.description: Creates a solid color JPEG image with specified width, height, and optional orientation.

methods.name: makeNoiseJPEG
methods.description: Creates a JPEG image filled with random noise.
